retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts: Fast-paced editing with frequent scene changes to maintain visual interest.
Looping Content: Design videos to seamlessly loop, encouraging multiple watches and extending watch time.
Text Overlays: Use dynamic, engaging on-screen text to reinforce points and grab attention.
Sound Design: Strategic use of trending sounds, engaging music, and satisfying sound effects.
Micro-Suspense: Introduce a mini-mystery or cliffhanger every few seconds to keep viewers hooked.
High Energy Delivery: Maintain an enthusiastic voice, quick movements, or vibrant visuals throughout.
